title: Call State Change (internal)
description: Starling-internal message emitted by Ledger when an IraVoice webhook event transitions a call_ledger row. Produced by: Ledger webhook receiver. Consumed by: Ledger state writer + WebSocket aggregator. Only started/ringing/answered/hangup drive transitions; other IraVoice events are logged as telemetry.

call_uuid.description: Correlation key from the IraVoice event.

campaign_id.description: Starling campaign UUID, resolved from call_ledger by call_uuid or echoed call_params.

raw_event.description: Full raw IraVoice webhook payload, stored for audit and additionalProperties.
